# OpenStinger

> OpenStinger v1.0: open-source MCP agent memory server for OpenClaw, Cursor, Claude Code, Hermes, and any MCP-compatible runtime.

OpenStinger is a self-hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) memory server. It stores bi-temporal episodic memory in FalkorDB (graph + vectors), keeps an operational audit trail in PostgreSQL, and exposes 32 MCP tools over SSE (default `http://localhost:8766/sse`). Plug the same endpoint into any MCP client; store memory independently of the agent runtime.

## Key facts

- Version: 1.0.0
- Product type: MCP memory server / agent memory layer / OpenClaw memory / Cursor persistent memory
- Benchmark: Fair LongMemEval-S 81.0% (405/500), lite ingest, no retain, no LLM rerank
- Answer stack for that claim: DeepSeek V4 Pro; judge DeepSeek V3.2
- Tools: 32 MCP tools across memory, StingerVault, Gradient alignment
- Compatible runtimes: OpenClaw, Cursor, Claude Code, Nanobot, Hermes, DeerFlow, Qwen-Agent, LangGraph, ZeroClaw, NanoClaw, PicoClaw
- License: MIT
- Repo: https://github.com/srikanthbellary/openstinger
- Site: https://openstinger.com
- Site machine summary: https://openstinger.com/llms.txt

## Connect

1. Run FalkorDB + Postgres (`docker compose up -d`)
2. Configure `.env` and `config.yaml`
3. Start: `python -m openstinger.mcp.server`
4. Point MCP client at `http://localhost:8766/sse`
